notes.title: 《Let's Patiti!》Update（2025.6.20）
notes.content:
[code]Dear Players,

Thank you for your continued support and patience! We are thrilled to announce the latest Steam update, which brings a series of optimizations and new features. Below are the detailed contents of this update:

\[This Update's Contents]

New Feature: Custom Lap Count!!!
In response to strong feedback from the player community, we prioritized the development and release of the "Custom Lap Count" feature! Now, you can freely adjust the number of laps in races to create your own unique racing experience.

Gameplay Optimizations
Fixed several known bugs, including issues with scene stuttering, abnormal physics collisions, and more.

Content Development Progress
We are working hard on developing new gameplay modes and features to bring you richer content in the future.

Modifications and additions to the large map models.

Overhauls and additions to the overall HUD.

UI changes to the room interface and room list.

Adjustments to certain grid events (e.g., "Super badlucky cell") that caused balance issues due to the custom lap count mode.

\[About the New Large Map]
We fully understand everyone's excitement for new content. However, after a comprehensive evaluation of our current development resources and project status, we regret to inform you that we will not be able to start the development of a new large map in the short term. Creating a high-quality new map requires significant investment and a lengthy development cycle.

\[Feedback and Future Plans]
Your suggestions are always our guiding light for improvement. Feel free to share your feedback via the Steam community or official group!

Feedback Collection: All your suggestions will be carefully documented (we’ve also gathered some player ideas through private chats and other channels) and serve as an important reference for future planning.

Update Priorities:

2.1 The team will focus on developing new gameplay modes and features to deliver a more diverse gaming experience.

2.2 Optimizing the current experience: Continuously refining game quality, addressing bugs, stuttering, and other issues reported by players.

2.3 Prioritizing high-demand features: Based on recent discussions with players, we’ve learned that "Custom Lap Count" is a highly requested feature. We’ve prioritized its development and will release it in tonight’s Steam update!

Once again, thank you for your support and passion! We will keep working hard to make Let's Patiti! even better.

Update now to experience the new content!

Let's Patiti! Development Team
June 20, 2025[/code]

notes.title: Update Notice 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We've got an update!

First off, we sincerely apologize for the recent subpar gaming experience!

We’ve been working non-stop to improve things!

Please restart Steam and update the game client!

What’s new in this update?

A brand-new outfit set is now unlocked! This was promised as compensation for the delayed DLC release.
Two more sets are coming after the Qingming Festival—stay tuned!
We hope you’ll enjoy these additions, and we’re truly sorry for the earlier multiplayer hiccups!
Patch Notes:

Fixed the spacebar unresponsiveness caused by network latency.
Resolved an issue where duplicate character creation blocked the host from switching roles after "Ready."
Fixed keyboard input failure during chat due to UI layer conflicts.
Addressed outfit initialization glitches when inviting players.
Optimized lag spikes triggered by network instability.
Fixed a bug where skipping card usage in the first round broke mini-games.
Added a graphics quality settings reminder.
PS: BIG NEWS! Our DLC has finally passed review!

The purchase page goes live at PT 2 AM tonight with a launch discount—40% OFF!

Just 0.99 USD for 12 outfits! Your support means the world to us! ❤️

notes.title: Update Notice 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We sincerely apologize for the issues caused by yesterday's update, which led to a poor gaming experience. We’re here to bow deeply in apology! 🙇♂️

Here are the bugs we’ve fixed:

Fixed the black screen bug that occurred after exiting mini-games.
Resolved the issue where players would glitch and run uncontrollably in the forest after using the [Dodge Smoke] skill.
Addressed unspecified bugs with inconsistent visual/behavioral effects (caused by the same underlying issue but manifesting differently for players).
Game Settings Recommendations:

For lightweight laptops: Enable Low Graphics Quality and set Anti-Aliasing to FXAA for smoother performance.
Screen rendering issues (e.g., yellow tint): Try switching between DX11/DX12 in settings and restart the game.
Update your GPU drivers to the latest version.
TSR Warning: Avoid using TSR (Temporal Super Resolution) as it may cause VRAM overload and performance issues.
Network lag: Use UU Accelerator and connect to our dedicated channel for stable multiplayer.
(Note: We currently do NOT partner with other accelerators—using them may worsen connectivity!)
Join our QQ support group for assistance: 106727313
Finally, thank you all for your support and feedback—we take every review (positive or critical) seriously and will keep improving!

Thank you all once again!!!

notes.title: Demo Update V0.0.3.3
notes.content:
Dear players,

We sincerely apologize for the issues you have encountered in the game. Due to a shortage of manpower in the development team, there may be delays in fixing bugs, but we are now fully committed to resolving these issues promptly. Thank you for your support and feedback~

We have updated to version v0.0.3.3. Before playing with your friends, please make sure you are using the same version. The update includes the following changes:

- Fixed the issue where casting spells quickly multiple times could cause the player's position to not return to the original place
- Fixed sound effect issues
- Fixed the problem of joining a full room
- Interactions optimized
- Addressed the issue that could trigger the second lap
- FXAA is now the default anti-aliasing option to prevent excessive lag (you can adjust this in the settings menu)

Please ensure that your graphics card drivers are up to date;
We currently do not recommend using accelerators to play the game;
For players using integrated graphics cards or with insufficient hardware configurations, if you encounter issues entering the game, you can try opening the "Patiti\Content\Cooperation\GameData\client\setting\Setting.json" file with Notepad, change the currentRHI configuration to DX12, save the file, and then restart the game;
If you have any questions, you can contact the development team on QQ or Little Red Book~

Happy Valentine's Day to all players~

Thank you for your support, and have a great time playing!

Let's Patiti! Game Development Team

February 14, 2025

notes.title: Demo Update V0.0.3.2
notes.content:
Dear players,

We sincerely apologize for the networking and other gameplay issues you have encountered in the game. We acknowledge that our launch right before the Spring Festival was not thoroughly planned. With only two client developers in our team, we faced manpower challenges leading to delayed bug fixes. Rest assured, we are now fully committed to resolving these issues promptly. Thank you for your support and feedback~

We have released the v0.0.3.2 update, please ensure your version matches your friends before playing together. The update includes the following changes:

- Fixed room join timeout
- Fixed the issues with private room operations
- Fixed the problem of incorrect room names
- Fixed the errors in card playing and mini-games
- Fixed the issue of players disconnecting in the buffet mode
- Fixed default display issues with mini-game items

Please make sure your graphics card drivers are up to date;
For players with integrated graphics cards or insufficient hardware configurations, if you encounter issues entering the game, you can try editing the "Patiti\Content\Cooperation\GameData\client\setting\Setting.json" file using Notepad. Change the configuration item currentRHI to DX12, save the file, and then restart the game;
Players experiencing lag can adjust graphics settings and anti-aliasing modes accordingly;
It is currently not recommended to use accelerators for gaming;
If you have any questions, feel free to contact the development team on QQ or Xiaohongshu for assistance or just chat !

Wishing all players a Happy New Year~

Thank you for your support and enjoy the game!

1/25/2025
